name: campaign-video-toolkit
description: End cards, product inserts and animatics for campaign films

scripts.render: npm run render:animatic && npm run render:endcard && npm run render:inserts
scripts.render:animatic: remotion render src/index.ts PleaseHold-Animatic-45 out/PleaseHold-Animatic-45.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:endcard: remotion render src/index.ts PleaseHold-EndCard out/PleaseHold-EndCard.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:inserts: remotion render src/index.ts PleaseHold-ProductInserts out/PleaseHold-ProductInserts.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
